description: This file defines the ReportsProvider class, a ChangeNotifier that manages and provides report data such as totals, weekly trends, and category breakdowns for a Flutter app's dashboard. It interacts with a ReportRepository to fetch data asynchronously and exposes methods and properties for UI consumption.

classes.name: ReportsProvider
classes.description: A provider class for managing report data, fetching data from the repository, and notifying listeners in a Flutter application.

methods.name: ReportsProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with an optional repository, defaulting to a singleton instance.

methods.name: loadMonth
methods.description: Asynchronously loads report data for a specified month and year, updating internal state and notifying listeners.

methods.name: mtdSpent
methods.description: Returns the amount spent in the current month-to-date period, defaulting to 0 if data not available.

methods.name: topExpenseCategory
methods.description: Returns the category with the highest expense, or null if no expenses are available.
